language_basics.title: Source files
language_basics.text: GRS source files use the .grs extension and UTF-8 text. A program is a set of event blocks; a Studio Model Logic file is plain GRS source.

language_basics.title: Two block styles
language_basics.text: Logic is declared with events. A block is written either with braces or with begin ... end; both compile to the same event model. Blocks must span several lines: the compiler rejects a block written on one line.

snippets.caption: begin ... end style (no parentheses or semicolons needed)
One-line block: rejected (GRS_SURFACE_NATIVE_STRUCTURE_REQUIRED)
snippets.diagnostic: GRS_SURFACE_NATIVE_STRUCTURE_REQUIRED: GRS source must declare logic with event (or on/routine/function compatibility) { } blocks, or with native 'begin <name> event ... end' blocks

language_basics.title: Statements and variables
language_basics.text: Statements are written like function calls, one per line, usually ending with a semicolon. set assigns a value to a symbol or attribute; inc and dec change a number.

snippets.caption: set / inc / dec / print

language_basics.title: Literals and operators
language_basics.text: Numbers, strings in double quotes, true, false and null are literals. Operators: + - * / == != < <= > >= && || !

snippets.caption: Arithmetic, comparison, boolean, literals

language_basics.title: Comments
language_basics.text: Line comments start with // and block comments are written /* ... */.

snippets.caption: Comments

language_basics.title: Conditions
language_basics.text: if / else if / else choose a branch from a condition.

snippets.caption: if / else if / else

language_basics.title: Loops
language_basics.text: while repeats while its condition is true; for iterates a list; break leaves a loop; continue skips to the next iteration.

snippets.caption: while with continue and break
for over a list

language_basics.title: User events and calls
language_basics.text: An event with parameters can be called like a function and can return a value. Parameters are positional.

snippets.caption: Declare and call an event

language_basics.title: Compatibility forms
language_basics.text: on, routine and function are accepted for compatibility and compile to the same event; new code should use event.

language_basics.title: Compile errors you will see
language_basics.text: These diagnostics come from the GRS compiler. A program with any error cannot be run.

snippets.caption: Unclosed block (GRS_SURFACE_UNCLOSED_BLOCK)
snippets.diagnostic: GRS_SURFACE_UNCLOSED_BLOCK: one or more GRS '{' or 'begin' blocks are not closed

snippets.caption: Removed verb (GRS_SURFACE_REMOVED_ACTION): use move_to(target)
snippets.diagnostic: GRS_SURFACE_REMOVED_ACTION: travel() was removed; GigaRoute has a single movement verb -- use move_to(<target>)

entries.title: Studio model modules
entries.purpose: Runs newly authored OHT, AMR and Conveyor modules together, including Conveyor-only models.
entries.syntax:
begin model.module event
    set(module_id, "belt_alpha"); set(runtime_kind, "conveyor"); ...
end
entries.notes: Declare ownership in each source file. Same module_id combines files; different modules keep separate events. Use runtime_kind oht, amr or conveyor. One fleet per OHT/AMR kind; multiple Conveyor modules are supported. Station names must match the current drawing and carrier. Compile applies the entire valid model; any error blocks a new Run. No manifest or saved .grproj is required. Pause/Resume retains the active program; Restart uses edited sources. Existing undeclared single-runtime models retain their own execution path.
entries.related: model.init, request_transport, every_event, Studio Station binding

entries.title: Studio Station binding
entries.purpose: Connects each declared module to its own physical domain before Run.
entries.notes: OHT requires Rail-attached Stations. Conveyor requires Stations on one uniquely connected nonbranching LINE path; curves and ambiguous routes are rejected. AMR requires floor Stations, not overhead Rail Stations. Use the existing Station menu's AMR floor Station action to create Level 0 ground-plane Stations. File names, print text and demo Station prefixes do not select equipment. Cross-module logical Load handoff uses call_transport(target_module, load_id, from_station, to_station).

entries.title: Conveyor job lifecycle
entries.purpose: Receives actual creation, movement, blocked, exit-ready, downstream-release and completion callbacks from the Conveyor job.
entries.syntax:
begin conveyor.job_created event
    ...
end
begin conveyor.job_moved event
    ...
end
begin conveyor.blocked event
    ...
end
begin conveyor.exit event
    ...
end
begin conveyor.released event
    ...
end
begin conveyor.job_completed event
    ...
end
entries.notes: Use request from <entry> to <exit> to enqueue real work. every schedules its first request after the specified interval. lifecycle symbols identify the module, Job, Load and actual microsecond timestamp and remain available after a wait. conveyor.exit is the stop-distance handoff-ready boundary; conveyor.released fires after downstream acceptance. conveyor.job_completed remains the ordinary completion boundary.
entries.related: Studio model modules, every_event, request_transport, call_transport

entries.title: GRS file
entries.purpose: Simulation Studio Model Logic source file.
entries.notes: GRS uses UTF-8 text. Both native { } blocks and the supported begin <name> event ... end surface compile to the same GRS event model; dotted canonical event names keep their exact spelling.

entries.title: Vehicle runtime type
entries.purpose: Declares which physical Vehicle runtime owns this GRS model.
entries.syntax:
begin model.vehicle_type.oht event
end
begin model.vehicle_type.amr event
end
entries.example:
begin model.vehicle_type.oht event
end

begin model.init event
    print("OHT model ready");
end
entries.notes: Declare exactly one marker for a typed model. Legacy Rail and Auto Simulation runs preserve Fleet Mode. Studio blocks an untyped GRS when the saved Fleet Mode is AMR; declare the intended type explicitly.

entries.title: Vehicle asset
entries.purpose: Selects an OHT or AMR Equipment instance whose embedded GLB is used by the matching runtime renderer.
entries.syntax:
begin model.vehicle_type.oht event
end
begin model.vehicle_asset.<project_instance_name> event
end
entries.example:
begin model.vehicle_type.oht event
end
begin model.vehicle_asset.oht_01 event
end
entries.notes: The selector suffix matches Equipment instance_name case-insensitively. With no selector, exactly one instance in the matching category (OHT Vehicle or AMR) is bound automatically. Zero or multiple candidates retain the legacy type-specific renderer and emit GRS_VEHICLE_ASSET_FALLBACK. A missing or wrong-type explicit selector blocks Run. The original static placement is hidden only while that View has matching runtime snapshots.
entries.related: Vehicle runtime type, Workspace Equipment, Simulation Studio 3D

entries.title: Actual From-To CSV
entries.purpose: Defines recurring From-To job releases used by Auto Simulation and Static Analysis.
entries.notes: Time Interval is seconds between recurring releases for that row. Static Analysis uses moves/hour = 3600 / Time Interval. Auto Simulation schedules first_due = Time Interval and then previous_due + Time Interval, so the first job is not forced at t=0.
entries.related: Actual From-To, Static Analysis, Auto Simulation

entries.title: event
entries.purpose: Declares unified GRS logic. Canonical engine events and user-defined callable events use the same declaration kind.
entries.notes: Parameters are comma-separated identifiers. __gigaroute.* is reserved.

entries.title: on
entries.purpose: Compatibility declaration for a canonical engine-bound event.
entries.notes: Use event for new code. on accepts canonical events only and cannot declare parameters.

entries.title: routine / function
entries.purpose: Compatibility aliases lowered to the same unified event implementation.
entries.notes: New Studio templates use begin NAME event ... end. The older event NAME { } form and these aliases remain accepted for compatibility.

entries.title: call / direct event call
entries.purpose: Invokes a user-defined GRS event. Expression-position calls return the event's return value.
entries.notes: Parameters are positional.

entries.title: if / else if / else
entries.purpose: Executes conditional branches.
entries.notes: Conditions use the GRS expression surface.

entries.title: while
entries.purpose: Repeats a block while its condition is true.
entries.notes: Use wait/resource/order-list coordination when model time must advance.

entries.title: for
entries.purpose: Iterates a snapshot list such as vehicle.schedjobs.
entries.notes: The iterable is evaluated once when the loop begins.

entries.title: break
entries.purpose: Leaves the innermost while/for loop.
entries.notes: Only valid inside a loop.

entries.title: continue
entries.purpose: Skips to the next iteration of the innermost loop.
entries.notes: Only valid inside a loop.

entries.title: return
entries.purpose: Returns a value from the current user-defined event/call.
entries.notes: The compiled runtime also has a null return at the natural end of an event.

entries.title: print
entries.purpose: Writes GRS output to the Script Print log and the Studio realtime log.
entries.notes: Arguments are rendered in order.

entries.title: wait
entries.purpose: Suspends the current process until the requested simulation time has elapsed.

entries.title: wait_until
entries.purpose: Suspends the current process on the runtime wait-channel path until the condition can be re-evaluated after a wake.
entries.notes: There is no periodic condition polling. Prefer explicit event/resource/order-list coordination for high-volume models.

entries.title: set
entries.purpose: Assigns a GRS symbol or supported writable entity/attribute target.

entries.title: inc
entries.purpose: Increments a numeric target.

entries.title: dec
entries.purpose: Decrements a numeric target.

entries.title: create
entries.purpose: Creates one script Load entity and returns its handle.
entries.notes: The current process continues; create does not fork execution.

entries.title: clone
entries.purpose: Clones a Load actor and forks execution from the following statement.
entries.notes: Copies script Load attributes/ownership metadata. This is intentionally different from create.

entries.title: tabulate
entries.purpose: Appends a value to a named runtime Table.

entries.title: insert
entries.purpose: Inserts an entity handle into a named Queue.
entries.notes: Position begin inserts at the front; other positions currently append.

entries.title: send
entries.purpose: Appends an entity handle to a named Queue.
entries.notes: Queue state is script/runtime-owned.

entries.title: move_to
entries.purpose: Single GigaRoute movement verb. Station targets move a Vehicle through the existing physical route; an unresolved string target is treated as a Queue name.
entries.notes: Station resolution has priority. travel() and move_into() are removed from product GRS.

entries.title: dispatch
entries.purpose: Creates a move ScheduleJob for a Vehicle. A Busy Vehicle keeps it in its own queue until an authoritative Idle boundary.

entries.title: claim
entries.purpose: Claims a Load for a Vehicle and creates a retrieve ScheduleJob.
entries.notes: Same-owner claim is idempotent. A different Vehicle cannot claim an already claimed Load.

entries.title: cancel
entries.purpose: Cancels a live script ScheduleJob handle.
entries.notes: If physical movement is already committed, route/pose are not rewound or teleported; the physical Load lifecycle still completes.

entries.title: configure
entries.purpose: Writes script-side configuration/custom attribute state for an explicit receiver or current actor.
entries.notes: Does not silently replace global Simulation Setup physical constants.

entries.title: preempt
entries.purpose: Makes an alive uncommitted ScheduleJob current. If the Vehicle is busy, the selection takes priority at the next Idle boundary.
entries.notes: Soft preempt only: no active-route deletion, rewind, teleport or forced phase mutation.

entries.title: use / get / reserve
entries.purpose: Acquires a named Resource. If it is at capacity, the current process waits until capacity becomes available.
entries.notes: Literal Resource names share one wake channel. Dynamic targets fall back to a single non-blocking acquisition attempt.

entries.title: free / release
entries.purpose: Releases a named Resource and wakes eligible waiters.

entries.title: wait_ordered
entries.purpose: Places the current actor on the currently implemented default OrderList and suspends it until ordered.
entries.notes: Current product implementation intentionally uses one implicit default OrderList for this action.

entries.title: order
entries.purpose: Releases pending actors from the default OrderList.

entries.title: model.init
entries.purpose: Runs once when an applied scripted simulation run starts.
entries.notes: Authoritative run-start binding.

entries.title: vehicle.init
entries.purpose: Runs once for each Vehicle when the scripted run is activated.
entries.notes: The current Vehicle actor is available through vehicle.*.

entries.title: dispatch.request
entries.purpose: Runs at an Idle dispatch-request boundary, including initial activation.
entries.notes: The ScheduleJob queue guard executes before ordinary dispatch-request logic.

entries.title: job.selected
entries.purpose: Runs once when a live ScheduleJob becomes a Vehicle's current_schedjob.
entries.notes: Implemented. The event actor is the ScheduleJob handle. Re-setting the same current job does not fire again. preempt() fires only when it actually changes the current job.

entries.title: job.finished
entries.purpose: Runs when the committed physical job has fully completed and the Vehicle reaches the authoritative Idle handoff.
entries.notes: Implemented. This is later than vehicle.setdown: configured Setdown dwell must finish first. The event actor is the completed ScheduleJob handle.

entries.title: vehicle.pickup
entries.purpose: Fires when a Vehicle reaches the physical Pickup boundary.
entries.notes: A claimed Load becomes onboard at physical Pickup.

entries.title: vehicle.setdown
entries.purpose: Fires when a Vehicle reaches the Setdown arrival boundary.
entries.notes: The Load remains onboard through configured Setdown dwell and unloads at the following Idle handoff.

entries.title: vehicle.start_move
entries.purpose: Fires at the first real linear movement in Retrieving/Moving after speed exceeds the meaningful threshold.
entries.notes: The internal 0.001 mm/s wake probe is excluded; the event threshold is >0.01 mm/s.

entries.title: vehicle.speed_change
entries.purpose: Fires when physical motion speed changes meaningfully, including acceleration/deceleration, Sensor BRAKE/STOP and curve-speed transitions.
entries.notes: First-class physical event. Empty handlers are optimized out of the physical hot path.

entries.title: vehicle.resume
entries.purpose: Fires when a Vehicle that previously moved resumes real movement after stopping.
entries.notes: Uses an authoritative physical speed transition.

entries.title: vehicle.approach_destination
entries.purpose: Fires on the first real movement within the final route segment toward the destination.
entries.notes: No arbitrary distance polling threshold is used.

entries.title: station.pass.<station>
entries.purpose: Fires when a Vehicle physically crosses the named Station control point.
entries.notes: Only Stations with non-empty handlers are watched. Repeat visits fire again per route occurrence.

entries.title: vehicle.id
entries.purpose: Dense Vehicle identifier for the current Vehicle actor.
entries.notes: Read-only physical identity.

entries.title: vehicle.station / from / destination
entries.purpose: Reads the current Station, job source and job destination of the Vehicle.
entries.notes: Returns null when the corresponding Station is invalid/unset.

entries.title: vehicle.phase / status
entries.purpose: Returns the current physical phase as a string: idle, retrieving, pickup, moving or setdown.

entries.title: vehicle.schedjobs
entries.purpose: Returns the current Vehicle's live script ScheduleJob handles as a list.
entries.notes: The list is scoped to one Vehicle; no Vehicle x Job fleet scan is required.

entries.title: vehicle.current_schedjob
entries.purpose: Gets/sets the selected current ScheduleJob for the Vehicle.
entries.notes: An incomplete explicitly selected retrieve can reserve an Idle Vehicle until its endpoints are supplied.

entries.title: Load attributes
entries.purpose: Reads script-side material-flow state for a Load.
entries.syntax:
load.id
load.name
load.vehicle
load.location
load.destination
load.onboard
load.alive
load.state
entries.notes: state is derived as created, claimed, onboard or stored. Vehicle physical pose is not duplicated in Load state.

entries.title: ScheduleJob attributes
entries.purpose: Reads stable script ScheduleJob metadata.
entries.syntax:
job.id
job.type
job.vehicle
job.load
job.location
job.released_us
job.alive
job.current
entries.notes: Current transport lifecycle types include move, retrieve and deliver.
entries.related: dispatch, claim, cancel, preempt, job.selected, job.finished

entries.title: Queue / Table / ObjectList size
entries.purpose: Returns the number of stored elements in supported runtime collections.
entries.notes: Read-only collection size query.

entries.title: length / substring
entries.purpose: Reads String length or returns a substring.

entries.title: operators
entries.purpose: Arithmetic, comparison and boolean operators for GRS expressions.

entries.title: vehicle / self
entries.purpose: Provides the current Vehicle actor surface and current actor custom-attribute surface.
entries.notes: Custom modeling state is script-side and does not overwrite physical Vehicle state.

entries.title: vehicle.work_check / vehicle.park_check
entries.purpose: Names are reserved in the canonical event namespace but are not physically wired yet.
entries.syntax:
begin vehicle.work_check event
    ...
end
begin vehicle.park_check event
    ...
end

entries.title: conveyor.enter
entries.purpose: Reserved for a Load entering an integrated Workspace Conveyor.
entries.related: Workspace Conveyor, Load, future Conveyor material runtime

entries.title: conveyor.exit
entries.purpose: Fires when the Conveyor job reaches an exit-ready handoff boundary.
entries.notes: This is an implemented callback. With stop-distance/backpressure flow it is the point where downstream call_transport can be issued.

entries.title: conveyor.transfer
entries.purpose: Reserved for an authoritative Conveyor-to-Conveyor material transfer.
entries.notes: No dedicated conveyor.transfer callback is wired. Cross-module logical handoff currently uses conveyor.exit / conveyor.released with call_transport.
entries.related: Workspace Conveyor, transfer, future Conveyor material runtime

entries.title: conveyor.blocked
entries.purpose: Fires when the Conveyor job enters its actual blocked/backpressure state.
entries.notes: This callback is emitted from the Conveyor runtime state transition; no synthetic polling timer is used.

entries.title: conveyor.released
entries.purpose: Fires after a blocked/exit-ready Conveyor Load is accepted by the downstream owner.

entries.title: conveyor.sensor.on
entries.purpose: Reserved for a real Conveyor sensor ON transition.
entries.notes: Conveyor Job movement does not implement a physical sensor state; this event remains reserved.
entries.related: Workspace Conveyor, sensor, future Conveyor material runtime

entries.title: conveyor.sensor.off
entries.purpose: Reserved for a real Conveyor sensor OFF transition.
entries.notes: Conveyor Job movement does not implement a physical sensor state; this event remains reserved.
entries.related: Workspace Conveyor, sensor, future Conveyor material runtime

entries.title: travel / move_into
entries.purpose: Historical subsystem-specific movement verbs are intentionally removed from product GRS.
entries.notes: Compiler emits GRS_SURFACE_REMOVED_ACTION and directs users to move_to().

entries.title: Work_Accept
entries.purpose: Optional read-only acceptance predicate for explicit GRS claim(load, vehicle).
entries.syntax:
begin Work_Accept(vehicle, load, pickup) event
    ...
end
entries.notes: Runs synchronously immediately before a new explicit script claim mutates Load/ScheduleJob state. It must return Bool. If absent, claim() behavior is unchanged. Native Random/Real dispatch and easy transport do not synthesize a Load just to call this predicate.

entries.title: WIP / Traffic capacity pattern
entries.purpose: Models endpoint/WIP capacity with the existing Resource acquire/release and targeted wake path.
entries.notes: Resource capacity is the authoritative capacity in this pattern. Station occupancy/reservation is physical Vehicle occupancy and is intentionally not treated as the same value.
entries.related: use, get, reserve, free, resource.capacity, station_occupancy_count

entries.title: catalog-only actions
entries.purpose: These statement forms are not executable in the current Simulation Studio product. Use the implemented function forms instead.
entries.syntax:
terminate / remove / add / delete
open / read / write / close
schedule / choose (statement form)
entries.related: choose, schedule_in, schedule_at, terminate_load, file_read_lines, Action Catalog

entries.title: return (no value)
entries.purpose: Returns from the current user-defined event without a value.
entries.notes: A bare return produces null. return(value) preserves the existing return-value behavior.

entries.title: clone source actor
entries.purpose: Forks script execution after cloning the selected Load actor.
entries.notes: With no EntityHandle argument, clone uses the current actor. With an explicit Load handle, that Load is copied (ownership/location/destination/onboard/custom attributes) and the cloned execution branch continues with the copied Load as actor. This is runtime execution machinery, not a user-facing Process declaration.
entries.related: create, Load, Runtime Clone, Event execution model

entries.title: insert optional position
entries.purpose: Inserts an entity into a named Queue with an optional position.
entries.syntax:
insert(item, queue)
insert(item, queue, "begin")
insert(item, queue, "end")
entries.notes: begin inserts at the front. Omitted position, end, and other current position values append.

entries.title: List.size
entries.purpose: Returns the number of values in a runtime List.

entries.title: Vehicle attribute aliases
entries.purpose: Documents implemented native aliases for Vehicle queries.
entries.syntax:
vehicle.location == vehicle.station
vehicle.schedulejobs == vehicle.schedjobs
vehicle.status == vehicle.phase
entries.notes: Aliases resolve to the same current physical/script state; they do not duplicate state.

entries.title: Vehicle zone
entries.purpose: Sets or reads a logical Vehicle zone such as building, floor, or operating area.
entries.notes: Zone is logical metadata. It does not automatically change routing, dispatch, Following, or Sensor behavior. Blank means UNASSIGNED.
entries.related: Path zone, current path zone, Simulation Setup Vehicle Zone

entries.title: Path zone
entries.purpose: Reads or changes the logical zone assigned to a directed Path ID.
entries.notes: This changes logical runtime metadata only. It does not change route weight, direction, physical length, or automatically restrict route search. Workspace Selected Path Zone is the authoring source for Path.zone.
entries.related: Vehicle zone, route weight, Workspace Selected Path Zone

entries.title: Path type (rail type name)
entries.purpose: Reads the rail type attribute of a directed Path ID: its type name and whether the rail belongs to OHT or AGV.
entries.notes: The type name is authored in Workspace (select rails and a Vehicle object, right-click Type Name...), by DXF layer AGV_PATH* (rail kind default), or by the model.module type_name field. A Vehicle spawns on the rails whose type name equals its own. Read-only at run time; it does not restrict routing.

entries.title: model.module type_name
entries.purpose: Declares the rail type name a module's Vehicles spawn on.
entries.notes: Supported for runtime_kind oht and agv. vehicle_count Vehicles spawn on rails whose type name is LINE_A (OHT: on that rail's Stations; AGV: on that rail). Without type_name, Workspace Vehicle objects with a Type Name, or the established placement, are used.

entries.title: Current Path zone
entries.purpose: Returns the zone of the Path the Vehicle currently occupies.
entries.notes: The value is read-only through these accessors. Use set_path_zone(pathId, zone) or Workspace Path settings to edit Path zone. Off-map Vehicles return an empty string.

entries.title: Event execution model
entries.purpose: Defines the Simulation Studio authoring policy: native model logic is event-centered and does not introduce a separate user-facing Process type.
entries.syntax:
begin model.init event
    ...
end
begin vehicle.pickup event
    ...
end
begin dispatch.request event
    ...
end
entries.notes: Simulation Studio Model Logic accepts native GRS source; historical model source should be translated to GRS before validation.
entries.related: event, model.init, vehicle.*, dispatch.request, clone, wait

entries.title: Simulation Setup + GRS workload
entries.purpose: Uses the Real or Random From-To workload selected in Simulation Setup while GRS adds user policy callbacks and model logic.
entries.syntax:
begin model.init event
    ...
end
begin vehicle.pickup event
    ...
end
begin vehicle.setdown event
    ...
end
entries.notes: This describes the existing single-runtime Studio path without model.module declarations. Real/Random From-To remains active even when configure_motion() is called. Declared Studio modules use their own job_source setting (script by default), independently of Auto Simulation Setup.
entries.related: Simulation Setup, Real From-To, Random From-To, configure_motion, disable_native_job_source

entries.title: disable_native_job_source
entries.purpose: Explicitly disables native Real/Random From-To release when the GRS model generates its own Load workload.
entries.notes: Call this only when GRS itself owns demand generation. configure_motion() does not change workload ownership. Declared modules with job_source=script disable native generation during preparation and need no explicit disable call. A Native declaration conflicts with explicit script transport or source-disable actions.
entries.related: configure_motion, create, spawn_event, file_read_lines, Simulation Setup

entries.title: oht.motion_off
entries.purpose: Turns off the OHT Pickup/Setdown transfer (Slide/Hoist) motion to keep the run light. Travel is unchanged.
entries.notes: Call from model.init with no arguments. The Core pickup/setdown stop time is kept, so simulation results do not change; only the Slide/Hoist animation is skipped and the carrier switches between port and gripper at the handoff point. The setting applies to the OHT module that declares it.

entries.title: oht.color_fixed
entries.purpose: Turns off the Vehicle-phase color change (Idle/Retrieving/Pickup/Moving/Setdown) so the OHT keeps its original model color.
entries.notes: Call from model.init with no arguments. Only the display color changes; travel, pickup/setdown time and simulation results are unchanged. Useful for recording videos where a constant OHT color is easier to follow.

entries.title: stk.motion_off
entries.purpose: Turns off STK Crane motion so the Crane does not move separately.
entries.notes: Call from model.init with no arguments, before the first outbound request. Crane X/Z travel, Fork extend/retract and the pickup/deposit hold time all become 0, so each Crane job step completes immediately. Inventory, Port Lane and handoff events still occur in the same order. Rejected once the first outbound has started.

entries.title: amr.motion_off
entries.purpose: Turns off the AMR transfer (load/unload) motion setting.
entries.notes: Call from model.init with no arguments. The AMR currently has no transfer motion, so the setting is only stored in the AMR engine; travel and the pickup/setdown stop time are unchanged.

entries.title: Readable function names
entries.purpose: Model functions use Pascal_Underscore names; equipment acronyms remain uppercase.
entries.syntax:
call OHT_System_Initialize()
call ASRS_Seed_Shelf_FOUP(101)
call AMR_System_Initialize()
call Conveyor_System_Initialize()
call Process_Complete()
entries.example:
begin Process_Complete event
    print "process complete"
end
entries.notes: Existing camelCase model declarations/calls remain compatible through one unambiguous case/underscore-insensitive alias. Canonical dotted hooks such as model.init, vehicle.pickup_complete, conveyor.blocked and equipment.load_arrived are unchanged. Existing snake_case runtime built-ins keep their implementation names; Help displays the same callable in readable Pascal_Underscore form.
entries.related: Runtime Function Index, Native OHT / ASRS Functions, Example Model Functions, Model Functions (current source)

entries.notes: Subject to the GRS file I/O policy.

entries.title: File_Write_Line(path, text)
entries.purpose: Writes a model-root-relative text line.
entries.notes: Subject to the GRS file I/O policy.

entries.title: File_Append_Line(path, text)

entries.notes: Subject to the GRS file I/O policy.

entries.title: Configure_Motion(...)
entries.purpose: Configures supported motion options.

entries.title: Disable_Native_Job_Source()
entries.purpose: Disables native Real/Random workload release for a GRS-owned workload.

entries.title: oht.motion_off()
entries.purpose: Disables the OHT Pickup/Setdown transfer (Hoist/Slide) motion; travel is unchanged.
entries.notes: Call from model.init. The Core pickup/setdown stop time is kept, so only the transfer motion is skipped.

entries.title: Preload_Buffer_Cell(cell)
entries.purpose: Places a new FOUP into an empty Buffer Cell at the start of the run.
entries.notes: Call from model.init, e.g. preload_buffer_cell("BUFFER_2_R1_C1"). The Cell becomes occupied exactly as after a completed store, so `move from buffer` can take it later.

entries.title: Buffer_Move_Cell_Wait(source_cell, target_cell [, vehicle])
entries.purpose: Moves the FOUP in one Buffer Cell into another empty Buffer Cell and waits until it is set down (GRS sentence: `move from buffer A to buffer B`).
entries.notes: The source Cell is freed at Pickup and the target Cell becomes occupied at Setdown. Rejected (logged) when the source is empty/reserved or the target is occupied/reserved/unreachable.

entries.title: oht.color_fixed()
entries.purpose: Turns off the Vehicle-phase color change so the OHT keeps its original model color.
entries.notes: Call from model.init. Only the display color changes; travel, pickup/setdown time and results are unchanged.

entries.title: stk.motion_off()
entries.purpose: Disables STK Crane X/Z travel and Fork motion; Crane pickup/deposit hold time also becomes 0.
entries.notes: Call from model.init before the first outbound. Crane job steps complete immediately without separate Crane movement.

entries.title: amr.motion_off()
entries.purpose: Disables the AMR transfer (load/unload) motion.
entries.notes: The AMR currently has no transfer motion, so this only records the setting for the Core engine.

entries.title: Spawn_Event(event_name, ...)

entries.title: Schedule_In(event_name, relative_seconds [, actor])

entries.notes: Argument capture beyond the target actor is Not Implemented (same limit as spawn_event/clone_to_event).

entries.title: Schedule_At(event_name, absolute_simulation_seconds [, actor])
entries.purpose: Starts a user event at an absolute simulation time.

entries.title: Clone_To_Event(event_name, ...)
entries.purpose: Clones the current execution actor into another event.

entries.purpose: Terminates a scripted Load.

entries.title: Vehicle_Resume_Hold(vehicle)

entries.title: Vehicle_Resume_Release(vehicle)

entries.title: Set_Vehicle_Color(vehicle, color)

entries.title: Declare_Attribute_Type(name, type)
entries.purpose: Declares the expected type (Bool/Integer/Number/String/Time/Distance/EntityRef) for a custom Attribute name.
entries.notes: Once declared, set()/configure() writes of a mismatched Value kind are rejected (returns false) instead of silently coercing to 0/"". Integer/Number/Time/Distance all gate on the same underlying Number kind -- GRS Value has no narrower numeric type, so the distinction is documentation/unit intent. Does not retroactively validate values already written.

entries.title: Attribute_Declared_Type(name)
entries.purpose: Returns the declared type name for a custom Attribute, or null if undeclared.

entries.title: Conveyor_Load_Count()

entries.title: Station_Distance(from, to)

entries.title: Station_Vehicle_List(station)

entries.title: Set_Path_Zone(path_id, zone)

entries.title: Set_Vehicle_Zone(vehicle, zone)

entries.title: Vehicle_Path_Zone(vehicle)

entries.title: Path_Type_Name(path_id)

entries.title: Path_Type(path_id)

entries.title: Vehicle_Type_Name(vehicle)

entries.title: Vehicle_Path_Type_Name(vehicle)

entries.title: Current_Path_Type_Name(vehicle)

entries.title: Resource_In_Use(resource)
entries.purpose: Returns current resource usage.

entries.purpose: Returns resource name.

entries.title: Station_Name(station)

entries.notes: Returns "" for an out-of-range index.

entries.title: Station_Occupancy_Count(station)

entries.notes: Projects the existing reservation counter as-is; there is no separate multi-vehicle capacity model to report, so capacity/remaining_space are Not Implemented rather than fabricated.

entries.title: Station_Reserved(station)

entries.title: Use(resource_name)

entries.title: Get(resource_name)
entries.purpose: Acquires one unit of a Resource (alias of use/reserve).

entries.title: Reserve(resource_name)
entries.purpose: Acquires one unit of a Resource (alias of use/get).

entries.title: Easy_Assign_Vehicle(vehicle)
entries.purpose: Assigns the easy-syntax Load to a Vehicle.
entries.notes: Normally generated by easy syntax.

entries.title: Easy_Create_Load(type)
entries.purpose: Creates the easy-syntax Load.
entries.notes: Normally generated by easy syntax.

entries.title: Easy_Transport_Retrieve(station, ...)
entries.purpose: Runs easy-syntax retrieve transport.

entries.purpose: Runs easy-syntax deliver-and-wait transport.
entries.notes: Normally generated by easy syntax.

entries.notes: Generated by: move from buffer <BUFFER_ID> to <Station> [using vehicle OHT_02].

entries.title: Humanoid_Create(name, place | name, x_m, y_m)
entries.purpose: Creates a Humanoid at a Station/defined place or x/y (m).
entries.syntax: call Humanoid_Create(name, place | name, x_m, y_m)
entries.notes: Battery starts full.

entries.title: Humanoid_Define_Place(name, x_m, y_m [, work_height_mm])
entries.purpose: Defines a named work place for humanoid_walk_to/pick/place.
entries.notes: Defined places win over Station names. Default work height is 900 mm.

entries.title: Humanoid_Define_Obstacle(name, x1_m, y1_m, x2_m, y2_m [, level_id [, z_min_m [, z_max_m]]])
entries.purpose: Defines a rectangular obstacle Humanoids walk around (optionally limited to a height range).
entries.syntax: call Humanoid_Define_Obstacle(name, x1_m, y1_m, x2_m, y2_m [, level_id [, z_min_m [, z_max_m]]])
entries.notes: Levels without obstacles keep straight-line x route_factor. A walk with no route is rejected. Already planned walks are not re-planned. Height range (default floor to ceiling): an obstacle blocks a Humanoid only if z_max > 0.1 m and z_min < its height, so a low curb is stepped over and an overhead beam is walked under. AMR positions at request time are treated as temporary obstacles on the walk.

entries.title: Humanoid_Remove_Obstacle(name)
entries.purpose: Removes an obstacle (true if it existed).
entries.notes: Affects walks requested afterwards.

entries.title: Humanoid_Define_Zone(name, x1_m, y1_m, x2_m, y2_m [, capacity [, level_id]])
entries.purpose: Defines a corridor/area that at most `capacity` (default 1) Humanoids may be walking through at once.
entries.syntax: call Humanoid_Define_Zone(name, x1_m, y1_m, x2_m, y2_m [, capacity [, level_id]])
entries.notes: A Humanoid entering from outside waits at the entrance until the zone has room (first-requested first-served). Only walking time inside the zone is counted; standing Humanoids and other vehicle types do not occupy it. Zones on one level must not overlap.

entries.title: Humanoid_Route_Distance(robot, place)
entries.purpose: Planned walking distance in m (obstacle detour x route_factor) without moving; -1 if unknown or unroutable.

entries.title: Humanoid_Zone_Wait(robot)
entries.purpose: Total seconds the Humanoid has waited at zone entrances.

entries.title: Humanoid_Set(robot, parameter, value)
entries.purpose: Overrides one spec value for one Humanoid.
entries.notes: walk_speed/carry_speed/cart_speed/accel/decel are m/s(^2); turn_speed deg/s; payload_one_arm/payload_two_arm/item_mass kg; *_seconds, robot_time_factor, route_factor, battery_capacity_wh, battery_percent, *_power_w, low_battery_percent, mass_kg.

entries.title: Humanoid_Spec([robot,] parameter)
entries.purpose: Returns a spec/body value (height_mm, shoulder_height_mm, max_reach_height_mm, forward_reach_mm, walk_speed, ...).

entries.title: Humanoid_Walk_To(robot, place)
entries.purpose: Turns and walks to a Station/defined place. Returns seconds.
entries.notes: Straight-line distance x route_factor with trapezoidal speed; carry/cart speeds apply automatically. Fires humanoid.arrived.

entries.title: Humanoid_Walk(robot, meters)
entries.purpose: Walks straight ahead. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Turn(robot, degrees)
entries.purpose: Turns in place (+ counter-clockwise). Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Stairs(robot, steps)
entries.purpose: Climbs (+) or descends (-) stair steps. Returns seconds.
entries.notes: Rejected while a cart is attached.

entries.title: Humanoid_Pose(robot, pose)
entries.purpose: Changes posture: stand, carry, reach_high, reach_mid, bend, crouch, kneel, sit. Returns seconds.
entries.notes: Joint-space synchronized move; the slowest joint (trapezoidal profile) sets the time.

entries.title: Humanoid_Pick(robot, item [, height_mm [, mass_kg]])
entries.purpose: Aligns, takes the posture for the height, reaches, grasps and lifts an item. Returns seconds.
entries.notes: Items above payload_one_arm use both hands. Height outside the reach envelope is rejected. Fires humanoid.pick_complete.

entries.title: Humanoid_Place(robot [, item] [, height_mm])
entries.purpose: Puts down the held item (right hand first). Returns seconds.
entries.notes: Fires humanoid.place_complete.

entries.title: Humanoid_Transfer(robot, item, from_place, to_place [, from_height_mm, to_height_mm])
entries.purpose: Walk + pick + walk + place in one call. Returns seconds.
entries.syntax: call Humanoid_Transfer(robot, item, from_place, to_place [, from_height_mm, to_height_mm])

entries.title: Humanoid_Handover(giver, receiver [, item])
entries.purpose: Hands an item to another Humanoid within arm reach. Returns seconds.
entries.notes: Both robots are busy until completion. Fires humanoid.handover_complete.

entries.title: Humanoid_Attach_Cart(robot, cart)
entries.purpose: Grips a cart handle; later walks use cart speed. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Detach_Cart(robot)
entries.purpose: Releases the cart. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Open_Door(robot [, door])
entries.purpose: Opens a door/cover. Returns seconds.
entries.notes: Standard time x robot_time_factor.

entries.title: Humanoid_Close_Door(robot [, door])
entries.purpose: Closes a door/cover. Returns seconds.
entries.notes: Standard time x robot_time_factor.

entries.title: Humanoid_Press_Button(robot [, count])
entries.purpose: Presses a button/switch count times. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Turn_Valve(robot, turns)
entries.purpose: Turns a valve/knob. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Type(robot, text | character_count)
entries.purpose: Types on an HMI/keyboard. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Scan(robot [, target])
entries.purpose: Reads a barcode/RFID. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Inspect(robot [, seconds [, target]])
entries.purpose: Visual inspection. Returns seconds.
entries.notes: Without seconds uses inspect_seconds x robot_time_factor.

entries.title: Humanoid_Fasten(robot [, count])
entries.purpose: Fastens bolts/screws. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Tool_Change(robot [, tool])
entries.purpose: Changes a hand tool. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Work(robot, seconds [, label])
entries.purpose: Any other job for a fixed time (manual assembly, cleaning, ...). Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Wait(robot, seconds)
entries.purpose: Idles for a fixed time. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Charge(robot [, target_percent])
entries.purpose: Charges the battery to target (default 100%). Returns seconds.
entries.notes: Fires humanoid.charged.

entries.title: Humanoid_Joint(robot, joint_name, degrees)
entries.purpose: Moves one joint to an absolute angle. Returns seconds.

entries.title: Humanoid_Joints(robot, joint_name, degrees [, joint_name, degrees ...])
entries.purpose: Moves multiple joints simultaneously. Returns seconds.
entries.syntax: call Humanoid_Joints(robot, joint_name, degrees [, joint_name, degrees ...])
entries.notes: The slowest joint determines the synchronized duration.

entries.title: Humanoid_Location(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns the current place name or null.
entries.notes: Committed place (the destination while walking).

entries.title: Humanoid_X(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns x (m).

entries.title: Humanoid_Y(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns y (m).

entries.title: Humanoid_Z(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns z (m) at the Humanoid position.

entries.title: Humanoid_Level(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns the Level ID the Humanoid stands on.

entries.title: Humanoid_Holding(robot [, hand])
entries.purpose: Returns the held item (left/right/any) or null.

entries.title: Humanoid_Free_Hands(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns the number of free hands (0..2).

entries.title: Humanoid_Battery(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns battery percent.
entries.notes: Fires humanoid.battery_low when crossing low_battery_percent.

entries.title: Humanoid_Busy(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns true until the current action ends.

entries.title: Humanoid_State(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns the current action name or idle.

entries.title: Humanoid_Posture(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns the current posture name.

entries.title: Humanoid_Distance(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns walked distance (m).

entries.title: Humanoid_Utilization(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns busy time / elapsed time since creation (0..1).

entries.title: Humanoid_Actions(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns completed action count.

entries.title: Humanoid_Last_Error(robot)
entries.purpose: Returns the last rejection reason or null.
entries.notes: Rejected actions return 0 seconds and fire humanoid.rejected.

entries.title: Humanoid_Self()
entries.purpose: Inside a humanoid.* event returns the Humanoid name.

entries.title: Humanoid_Event_Action()
entries.purpose: Inside a humanoid.* event returns the action name.

entries.title: Humanoid_Count()
entries.purpose: Returns the number of Humanoids in this module.

entries.title: Humanoid_Joint_Deg(robot, joint_name)
entries.purpose: Returns the committed target angle of one Humanoid joint.

entries.title: vehicle.id [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the dense runtime Vehicle/Robot ID.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR. Physical runtime identity; not a user-defined attribute.

entries.title: vehicle.station [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the current/last Station index.
entries.notes: Type: Number or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR. Alias vehicle.location resolves to the same value.

entries.title: vehicle.from [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the current Job source Station index.
entries.notes: Type: Number or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: vehicle.destination [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the current destination Station index.
entries.notes: Type: Number or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: vehicle.phase [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the authoritative runtime phase/status text.
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR. Alias vehicle.status resolves to the same value.

entries.title: vehicle.current_speed [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns authoritative current linear speed.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm/s). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR. OHT reads the Rail Vehicle motion speed; AMR reads the robot linear speed.

entries.title: vehicle.remaining_distance [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns remaining distance on the current route.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR. Zero is valid at a destination or when no route is active.

entries.title: vehicle.x [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns current world X position.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: vehicle.y [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns current world Y position.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: vehicle.heading [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns current heading in radians.
entries.notes: Type: Number (rad) or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR. OHT can return null only when a legacy snapshot has no authoritative heading.

entries.title: vehicle.rotating_in_place [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns true while the runtime is rotating in place.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: vehicle.current_path [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the directed Rail Path ID currently occupied by the OHT.
entries.notes: Type: Number or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. AMR free-floor motion has no equivalent Rail Path ID.

entries.title: vehicle.has_assigned_job [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns whether the physical OHT owns a real transport Job.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. This is physical Job ownership, not merely a script custom attribute.

entries.title: vehicle.service_remaining_seconds [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns remaining Pickup/Setdown service time.
entries.notes: Type: Number (s). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. Returns zero outside Pickup/Setdown.

entries.title: vehicle.service_duration_seconds [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns configured duration of the active Pickup/Setdown service phase.
entries.notes: Type: Number (s). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. Returns zero outside Pickup/Setdown.

entries.title: vehicle.angular_speed [AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns current AMR angular speed.
entries.notes: Type: Number (rad/s). Access: read-only. Modules: AMR.

entries.title: vehicle.z [AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns current AMR 2.5D elevation.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm). Access: read-only. Modules: AMR.

entries.title: vehicle.traffic_state [AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns AMR traffic state text (Cruise/Slow/Stop).
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: AMR.

entries.title: vehicle.schedjobs [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the alive ScheduleJobs associated with the OHT Vehicle.
entries.notes: Type: List<ScheduleJob>. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. AMR automatic dispatch does not expose this OHT ScheduleJob list.

entries.title: vehicle.current_schedjob [OHT]
entries.purpose: Gets or selects the current OHT ScheduleJob.
entries.notes: Type: ScheduleJob or null. Access: read/write. Modules: OHT. Only a live job owned by the same Vehicle can be selected.

entries.title: vehicle.battery [AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns AMR battery percentage.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: AMR.

entries.title: vehicle.blocked_by [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the directly recorded leader/blocker Vehicle, or null when not currently blocked.
entries.notes: Type: Vehicle or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR. Only the Core-recorded direct blocker is returned. Dependency chains and root cause are not inferred.

entries.title: vehicle.blocked_since_seconds [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the simulation time this Vehicle began waiting on its current blocked_by, or null when not blocked.
entries.notes: Type: Number (s) or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: vehicle.blocked_elapsed_seconds [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns current simulation time minus blocked_since_seconds, or null when not blocked.
entries.notes: Type: Number (s) or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR. Computed on read from the existing blocked_since timestamp; no extra polling state is created.

entries.title: vehicle.waiting_for_station [AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns true while the AMR finished loading/unloading but is waiting for its destination Station slot to free.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: AMR. Event-driven: re-evaluated only when the Station frees, not polled.

entries.title: load.id [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the script Load ID.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: load.name [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the script Load name.
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: load.vehicle [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the claimed/onboard Vehicle handle.
entries.notes: Type: Vehicle or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: load.location [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns or supplies the off-Vehicle source/location Station.
entries.notes: Type: Number or null. Access: read/write. Modules: OHT. Writes participate in pending scripted transport endpoint binding.
entries.related: load.from / load.source aliases are accepted by transport binding

entries.title: load.destination [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns or supplies the active delivery destination Station.
entries.notes: Type: Number or null. Access: read/write. Modules: OHT. Writes participate in pending scripted transport endpoint binding.
entries.related: load.to / load.target aliases are accepted by transport binding

entries.title: load.onboard [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns true while the Load is physically onboard its carrier.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: load.alive [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns whether the script Load is live.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: load.state [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns created, claimed, onboard, or stored.
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. Derived from current script material ownership/location.

entries.title: buffer.id [OHT]
entries.purpose: Canonical Cell ID BUFFER_<instance>_R<row>_C<column>.
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.name [OHT]
entries.purpose: Alias of the canonical Cell ID.
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.type [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns side_buffer_cell.
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.enabled [OHT]
entries.purpose: True for an authored Cell registered into the active model session.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.group_id [OHT]
entries.purpose: Canonical Buffer group ID BUFFER_<EquipmentInstanceId>.
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.instance_id [OHT]
entries.purpose: Workspace Equipment instance ID that owns this Cell.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.row [OHT]
entries.purpose: 1-based row index.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.column [OHT]
entries.purpose: 1-based column index.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.capacity [OHT]
entries.purpose: One FOUP per Cell.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.occupied [OHT]
entries.purpose: True only after the physical Setdown dwell completes.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. A reservation alone is not occupancy.

entries.title: buffer.reserved [OHT]
entries.purpose: True while a store or retrieve transport owns this Cell.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.available [OHT]
entries.purpose: True only when not occupied and not reserved.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.load [OHT]
entries.purpose: Stored or reserved Load Entity.
entries.notes: Type: Load or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.load_id [OHT]
entries.purpose: Script Load ID for the stored/reserved Load.
entries.notes: Type: Number or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.logical_load_id [OHT]
entries.purpose: Cross-module logical Load ID when one exists.
entries.notes: Type: Number or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.station [OHT]
entries.purpose: Rail Station used as the Cell transfer point for the current stored/reserved Load.
entries.notes: Type: Number or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.state [OHT]
entries.purpose: empty, reserved_store, occupied, or reserved_retrieve.
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.x [OHT]
entries.purpose: Authored world X of the Cell transfer/support point.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.y [OHT]
entries.purpose: Authored world Y of the Cell transfer/support point.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.z [OHT]
entries.purpose: Authored world Z of the Cell transfer/support point.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.width [OHT]
entries.purpose: Clear internal Cell width.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.depth [OHT]
entries.purpose: Clear internal Cell depth.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.height [OHT]
entries.purpose: Clear internal Cell height.
entries.notes: Type: Number (mm). Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: buffer.occupied_since_seconds [OHT]
entries.purpose: Elapsed simulated time since the latest completed store.
entries.notes: Type: Number (s) or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. Computed on read; no polling timer.

entries.title: buffer.updated_us [OHT]
entries.purpose: Simulation timestamp of the latest reservation/occupancy transition.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: job.id [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the stable ScheduleJob ID.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: job.type [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns current move/retrieve/deliver job type.
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: job.vehicle [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the owning Vehicle.
entries.notes: Type: Vehicle or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: job.load [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the associated Load for material jobs.
entries.notes: Type: Load or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: job.location [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns or changes the target Station of an uncommitted job.
entries.notes: Type: Number or null. Access: read/write before commit. Modules: OHT. Committed physical jobs reject location rewrites.

entries.title: job.released_us [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the script release time in microseconds.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: job.alive [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns whether the ScheduleJob is live.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: job.current [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns whether the ScheduleJob is selected as current work.
entries.notes: Type: Bool. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: queue.size [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the current number of Queue items.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: queue.head [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the first item in the Queue, or null when empty.
entries.notes: Type: EntityRef or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: queue.tail [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the last item in the Queue, or null when empty.
entries.notes: Type: EntityRef or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: resource.capacity [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the configured Resource capacity.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: resource.in_use [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the current number of acquired Resource units.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: resource.available [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns capacity minus in_use.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR. See resource.holder_count/waiter_count/holders/waiters/oldest_hold_seconds/oldest_wait_seconds for ownership. free() releases a unit held by the same process, else by the same actor (cross-event Load flow); any other free or a double free is rejected with [SIM_SCRIPT_RESOURCE_RELEASE_REJECT].

entries.title: resource.state [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns "full" when in_use >= capacity, otherwise "available".
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: resource.holder_count [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the number of acquired Resource units tracked by the script runtime.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. Ownership is process-scoped; physical Equipment ownership is not implied.

entries.title: resource.waiter_count [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns the number of processes waiting for Resource capacity.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. Waiters are registered only after a failed acquire and wake through the existing targeted Resource channel.

entries.title: resource.holders [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns actors associated with current Resource claims.
entries.notes: Type: List<EntityRef>. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. Processes without an Entity actor still count in holder_count but are omitted from this EntityRef list.

entries.title: resource.waiters [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns actors associated with current Resource waits.
entries.notes: Type: List<EntityRef>. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT. Processes without an Entity actor still count in waiter_count but are omitted from this EntityRef list.

entries.title: resource.oldest_hold_seconds [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns elapsed simulation time since the oldest current Resource acquisition.
entries.notes: Type: Number (s) or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: resource.oldest_wait_seconds [OHT]
entries.purpose: Returns elapsed simulation time since the oldest current Resource wait began.
entries.notes: Type: Number (s) or null. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT.

entries.title: orderlist.size [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the current number of pending OrderList entries.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: table.size [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the current number of Table cells.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: objectList.size [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the current number of ObjectList items.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: list.size [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns the number of values in a runtime List.
entries.notes: Type: Number. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: text.substring [OHT, AMR]
entries.purpose: Returns a substring using zero-based start and length.
entries.notes: Type: String. Access: read-only. Modules: OHT, AMR.

entries.title: OHT_System_Initialize()
entries.purpose: Initializes the native OHT model session.
entries.notes: Uses the existing OHT engine.

entries.title: ASRS_Stocker_Initialize()
entries.purpose: Initializes stocker inventory and cycle state.
entries.notes: Call before shelf seeding and first outbound.

entries.title: ASRS_External_Handoff_Mode()
entries.purpose: Hands outbound FOUPs to downstream modules.
entries.notes: Set before the first outbound cycle.

entries.title: ASRS_Seed_Shelf_FOUP(foup_id)
entries.purpose: Seeds one FOUP in initial shelf inventory.
entries.notes: Requires initialized stocker.

entries.title: ASRS_Request_First_Outbound()
entries.purpose: Starts the first outbound cycle.
entries.notes: Requires initialized stocker and occupied shelf inventory.

entries.title: ASRS_Current_FOUP()
entries.purpose: Returns the active outbound FOUP ID or null.

entries.title: ASRS_Capacity()
entries.purpose: Returns the total Shelf slot capacity.

entries.title: ASRS_Occupied_Count()
entries.purpose: Returns the current number of occupied/reserved-outbound Shelf slots.

entries.title: ASRS_Free_Count()
entries.purpose: Returns the current number of empty Shelf slots.

entries.title: ASRS_Slot_Load(slot_index)
entries.purpose: Returns the FOUP ID stored at a Shelf slot index, or null if empty.

entries.title: ASRS_Crane_Count()
entries.purpose: Returns the number of Cranes in the Stocker.

entries.title: ASRS_Crane_State(crane_index)
entries.purpose: Returns the Crane's current handoff state.
entries.notes: One of idle/move_to_pickup/picking/move_to_storage/storing/move_to_retrieve/retrieving/move_to_output/unloading.

entries.title: ASRS_Add_In_Lane(station, slot_count[, transfer_height_mm])
entries.purpose: Adds an inbound Port Lane: OHT sets down at the Station, then an N-slot conveyor feeds the Crane.
entries.notes: Call after asrs_stocker_initialize and before asrs_request_first_outbound. Masks one Shelf cell as slot 0. Returns the lane index.

entries.title: ASRS_Add_Out_Lane(station, slot_count[, transfer_height_mm])
entries.purpose: Adds an outbound Port Lane: the Crane deposits ahead into an N-slot conveyor and OHT picks up at the Station.
entries.notes: Same call order as asrs_add_in_lane. Returns the lane index.

entries.title: ASRS_Add_Bidirectional_Lane(station, slot_count, direction[, transfer_height_mm])
entries.purpose: Adds a Port Lane whose direction ("in" or "out") can change while it is empty.
entries.notes: Use asrs_set_lane_direction to switch. Returns the lane index.

entries.title: ASRS_Set_Lane_Direction(lane, direction)
entries.purpose: Switches a bidirectional Port Lane to "in" or "out".
entries.notes: Returns false if the lane is not bidirectional or still holds FOUPs.

entries.title: ASRS_Set_Lane_Slot_Move_Seconds(lane, seconds)
entries.purpose: Sets how long the conveyor takes to advance a FOUP by one slot.
entries.notes: Call before asrs_request_first_outbound.

entries.title: ASRS_Lane_Count()
entries.purpose: Returns the number of Port Lanes.

entries.title: ASRS_Lane_Slot_Load(lane, slot)
entries.purpose: Returns the FOUP ID physically on a Lane slot, or null if empty or only reserved.
entries.notes: slot 0 is the Crane end; the last slot is the OHT end.

entries.title: ASRS_Set_Rack(bays, levels, cell_width_mm, cell_height_mm, cell_depth_mm)
entries.purpose: Sets the Rack size (default 8 x 6, 650 x 500 x 700 mm). Replaces the empty Stocker, so no Lane or seeded FOUP may exist yet.
entries.syntax: call ASRS_Set_Rack(bays, levels, cell_width_mm, cell_height_mm, cell_depth_mm)
entries.notes: Call right after asrs_stocker_initialize. Example: asrs_set_rack(10, 6, 450, 400, 1000) is the default Place STK.

entries.title: ASRS_Add_In_Port(station, bay, level [, depth_mm])
entries.purpose: Uses one front-column Shelf cell as an In Port (a one-slot Lane): the OHT sets down straight into that cell and the Crane stores from it.
entries.notes: Call after asrs_set_rack and before asrs_request_first_outbound. The OHT transfer height is the cell's FOUP centre height. Returns the lane index.

entries.title: ASRS_Add_Out_Port(station, bay, level [, depth_mm])
entries.purpose: Uses one front-column Shelf cell as an Out Port (a one-slot Lane): the Crane retrieves into that cell and the OHT picks up from it.
entries.notes: Same call order as asrs_add_in_port. Returns the lane index.

entries.title: ASRS_Set_Out_Buffer(cell_id)
entries.purpose: Adds a Side Buffer Cell as a destination for FOUPs leaving an Out Lane; each FOUP reserves the first free candidate and the Cell becomes occupied when the OHT Setdown completes.
entries.notes: Call after asrs_stocker_initialize and before asrs_request_first_outbound, once per Cell. Lane mode only. A Load set down on an In Lane Station by any other OHT job is accepted by that Lane automatically.
